correctness.rationale: In the bilateral shift an A=11 bond followed by a consecutive B=00 bond bounds exactly 11(01)^j00, of gap 2(j+1). The local tables give A motion left and B motion right, with only separation-two B,A pairs deleted. Surviving defects preserve order: only B,A gaps shrink, and at the smallest possible gap their defects disappear rather than cross. For consecutive output A,B, their ordered ancestors bracket at least one consecutive input A,B transition, so the ancestral gap is at least 2(t+1) on X_t and the output gap at least 2(t+2). Conversely the Rule-226 reflected branch G moves A right and B left; there are no collisions on an output avoiding 1100, and the remaining gaps after G meet X_t's bound. The five-bit discrepancy table shows F(Gy)=y on that shift. Thus F(X_t)=X_{t+1}, including t=0, and induction gives every stage. Basis words are pairwise noncontaining because their only 11 and 00 are the terminal defects. Every finite avoiding word can be extended by a constant zero left tail and constant one right tail without creating an A-to-B defect pair. Therefore the avoiding-word languages are actual bilateral image languages, the basis is exactly minimal, and W_t is in Y_t but not Y_{t+1}, the first difference at length 2t+4. The independent bounded replay script independent_check.py checked the full four- and five-bit tables and 32 finite-block cases through t=4 (largest input block length 14); those checks supplement the all-time induction. The shipped verifier was inspected, not executed. No finite-ring or asynchronous generalization is asserted.
